items.title: fix(update): wait for native maintenance before activation (#176131)
items.summary: fix(update): wait for native maintenance before activation (#176131) A managed Git update could stop the serving Gateway and then abort before checkout because its execution guard hit a foreign SQLite maintenance owner, falling back to the previous build. The guard now waits for foreign maintenance (at most 30 s and never past the update deadline, cancellable) before stopping the Gateway and before checkout, retrying only the guarded read; authority and recovery checks are unchanged, and on expiry the update defers with the maintenance owner's PID/role and stays rollback-eligible. Fixes #175913
